messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to the current clock, so I can’t give you the exact time right now.  
The easiest way to find the current time in New York City is to check a reliable world‑clock website or app (e.g., timeanddate.com, the built‑in clock on most smartphones, or a quick “current time in New York” Google search). That will give you the precise local time, including any daylight‑saving adjustments.

But we might need to use a function? There's no function for time. We can compute based on UTC. But we don't know current UTC. We could approximate using system time? We don't have that. We can respond that we don't have real-time capability. We can suggest using a reliable source. So answer: I can't provide real-time. Suggest checking a world clock.
